tools.name: equicty_list_public_horses
tools.description: List the horses the stable marked public for its website: name, age, birthday, sex, studbook, colour, height, 3-generation pedigree, and profile and miniature image URLs. Only public horses are returned; private horses are not reachable through this API. Equicty Website API: POST /horses.

tools.name: equicty_get_public_horse
tools.description: Get one public horse by id, including its pedigree, profile and miniature image URLs, and the videos and pictures the stable made public. Only public horses are reachable. Equicty Website API: GET /horses/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: equicty_list_public_horses, equicty_get_public_horse · Private data: equicty_list_public_horses · Public sink: equicty_list_public_horses.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: equicty_list_public_horses, equicty_get_public_horse · Private data: equicty_list_public_horses · Public sink: equicty_list_public_horses

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
